Order:

This petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashment of the proceedings in C.C.No.9935 of 2023 pending on the file of the learned XV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad, against the petitioner/accused.

entities.text: XV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
[
2. Heard Mr.Praveen Kumar Challa, learned counsel for petitioner, Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
3.
The petitioner is arrayed as sole accused in C.C.No.9935 of 2023 facing accusation under Sections 498-A, 406, 420 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that though the petitioner got a strong case even for quashment, as he is determined to see the process through, the insistence for his presence is causing severe difficulty in pursuing his occupations and avocations.
Therefore, prayed for dispensing his personal appearance in the proceedings, unless presence in person is required and such direction would redress his grievance.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that there is no specific objection for the prayer,
however pleaded for a direction for appearance of the petitioner on the material stages in the proceedings.
6.

Having regard to the submissions, subject to the petitioner appearance through their counsel on every adjournment and physical presence as and when directed by the Court, the in-person presence of the petitioner in the proceedings of the C.C.No.9935 of 2023 pending on the file of the learned XV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad, is dispensed with.

entities.text: XV Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Additionally it is specified that any lapse in abiding the above conditions would render this order ineffective.
7. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
